full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A fretless bass provides melodic counterpoint with frequent slides. The drum kit uses a soft snare with high reverb and a subtle kick. Orchestral string pads enter during the second half of the verse to provide harmonic density. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, in the key of G Major.
